title: 紧急情况：生病、丢东西、求助
goal: 会描述症状、在药店买药，东西被偷或护照丢失时会报警、联系大使馆。
tips: 急救电话：美国、加拿大 911；欧盟 112；英国 999（112 也能打）；澳大利亚 000。出发前查好目的地的号码。
丢了护照：先去警察局开报案证明（police report），再联系中国驻当地使领馆补办旅行证件。
说症状：I have a fever / a headache / a stomachache. I feel sick.（我想吐/不舒服）

exchanges.reply: My friend fainted. Please send an ambulance.
exchanges.replyZh: 我朋友晕倒了，请派救护车。

exchanges.reply: I have a fever and a headache.

exchanges.hear: How long have you felt like this?
Are you allergic to any medicine?
Take one tablet three times a day after meals.
exchanges.hearZh: 一天三次，每次一片，饭后吃。
exchanges.reply: Three times a day after meals. Got it.

exchanges.hear: When did you last see it?
exchanges.hearZh: 你最后一次看到它是什么时候？
exchanges.reply: On the bus, about an hour ago.
exchanges.replyZh: 大约一小时前，在公交车上。

exchanges.hear: You should contact your embassy for a new passport.
exchanges.hearZh: 你应该联系你们的大使馆补办护照。

exchanges.reply: Yes. Can I get a police report for my insurance?
exchanges.replyZh: 有。能给我一份报案证明用来理赔吗？

lines.en: Hi. How can I help you?
I have a bad stomachache, and I feel sick.
Are you allergic to any medicine?
OK. Take one of these tablets three times a day after meals, and drink lots of water.
lines.zh: 好的。这个药一天三次，每次一片，饭后吃，多喝水。

lines.en: Thank you. What should I do if I don't feel better?
lines.zh: 谢谢。如果还不好，我该怎么办？

lines.en: Then you should see a doctor. There's a clinic across the street.
lines.zh: 那你应该去看医生。街对面有一家诊所。
